summary_bullets: Treat empty aggregator output (no FINDING blocks) as success so duplicate-only reviews do not fail validation.
Normalize trailing parentheticals on reviewer slot labels before matching input slots, covering LLM suffixes such as coverage notes.
Document the validator behavior and lock both shapes in the offline harness.
commit_message:
Fix aggregate-findings validator for empty merge and labelled slots

Treat zero FINDING blocks in merge output as validation success (#2536).
Normalize trailing parentheticals on reviewer slot labels before
matching input slots. Add harness coverage and update sibling doc.
